description: mctable is a Power BI custom visual for teams that need to review, edit, validate, and write data back from inside a report. It combines spreadsheet-style table interaction with controlled workflows, including per-column validation, change tracking for inserted, modified, and deleted rows, and writeback to your own API. The visual is built for operational scenarios such as master data maintenance, exception handling, and governed data correction. It also offers extensive configuration for column behavior, paging, layout, styling, and footer actions, so the table can fit both internal business applications and white-labeled embedded solutions.
